purpose: Separate adjacent burdens so future records do not flatten all worker distress into burnout.

terms.definition_for_cube: grief related to work-based relationship, care, witness, or responsibility after a death
erosion, numbness, or depletion associated with repeated compassionate exposure
terms.not_to_be_used_as: accusation that a worker stopped caring

terms.definition_for_cube: workforce and organizational exhaustion involving workload, control, recognition, values, or sustainability
distress when a worker believes they know the ethically appropriate action but cannot act accordingly
terms.not_to_be_used_as: public blame without source and review

terms.definition_for_cube: deeper moral harm associated with betrayal, constraint, violation, or participation in events conflicting with moral commitments
stress symptoms linked to exposure to others traumatic experiences or materials

rendering_rule: Use these as boundary terms in quarantined records. Public use requires worker-support and clinical/occupational-health language review.
